text:
B: Hello, er, hiya. Can you hear me okay?
A: Yeah. Tracey.
B: Callum. Down in Taunton. You're London, is it? I saw the Tower Bridge on your wall.
A: Dagenham. That's just a picture. Gary got it off Facebook Marketplace.
B: Nice. So, er, are you working today?
A: Five till nine. Office cleaning in Romford.
B: Ah, evenings. That's a long day if you've been up early.
A: It's alright. Nobody's about once they go home. I just put one earphone in and crack on, d'you know what I mean.
B: Yeah, I get that. I'm a joiner. When I'm on my own in the workshop with a podcast on, that's the best bit of the day, honestly.
A: What, like, building stuff?
B: Windows, doors, old houses mostly. And bits of furniture in my mum's garage. I found a proper old Stanley plane at a car boot last weekend for a fiver. Bit rusty, but I've cleaned it up and it's lovely now, cuts like butter. You'd pay sixty quid for one online.
A: A fiver? Nice one. I love a bargain. I'm always on Vinted. Problem is I buy stuff, it don't fit, and I miss the return.
B: Ha, that's the trap.
A: Every time. Gary goes mad. There's a bag in the box room full of stuff I ain't sent back.
B: Is Gary your husband?
A: Yeah. He's a delivery driver. You look a bit like him, actually. Chilled out. Not the face, just the, d'you know what I mean.
B: Ha, I'll take that. I'm not sure my boss would call me chilled. He's always chasing me for timesheets.
A: Oh, timesheets, don't. They're a nightmare. You forget one week and suddenly it's a whole thing.
B: Exactly that. I write my hours on bits of wood and lose them.
A: Ha. On wood. You was asking for it, then.
B: Fair. Er, have you got any pets?
A: Duchess. Old Staffy. Her back legs are going. Everyone keeps saying hydrotherapy, but it's forty quid a go, so.
B: That's a lot. My stepdad built a little ramp for our old dog when his hips went, so he could get up the back step. Just a few bits of timber with carpet on. Made all the difference.
A: Yeah? How'd he do that?
B: Just a plank, couple of battens underneath, offcut of carpet stapled on so they don't slip. Takes an hour. I could tell you the measurements, if you want.
A: Gary could do that. He's got loads of wood in the box room for no reason.
B: There you go, then. Sorted.
A: Is this what they want, d'you reckon? Just chatting about dogs?
B: Er, I think so. I'm not sure there's a wrong answer, to be...
